text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is trying out her signature racewear at today's training to see how it feels while running.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Commencing ramp training. Master, please provide specific instruc—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Master?
The more I look, the more I can't help but think her outfit is straight out of a sci-fi movie. It suits her, but I still wonder what she was thinking with such a design.
choice_data_list: Did you design your outfit yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I apologize. I should have asked for your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You appeared busy at the time, therefore I consulted with my father instead.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: His exact response was, "Think for yourself. Your master would probably say the same."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Once I heard that, I began crafting a design that I would consider to be S-rank.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There are no issues with mobility or range of motion. I have determined that this design will allow me to maximize my performance at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But your question intrigues me. Do you see a problem with it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Curious?
Signature racewear is a very important outfit for a racer. The emotional attachment is likely even stronger when they've designed their own.
I explain to her that that is why I was interested in her reason for the design.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Do you have some time after training?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I shall satisfy your curiosity then.
After training, she takes me to…
A planetarium. I suppose this is where she got her inspiration from.
choice_data_list: Did you base your design on a spaceship?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Not exactly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: To be more precise, an outer space jet fighter… perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes. One day, when I was young, my father turned on the television to check the weather forecast.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But instead, a cartoon depicting outer space appeared on the screen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: There were red trails of light from a star fighter cutting through the asteroids.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I was awestruck by its immeasurable energy—its overwhelming speed and cutting-edge technology.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My father didn't change the channel. Instead, he spoke to me as I watched.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I recall him saying, "Isn't that neat? Look at how fast it's going."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It was a power even my father approved of—something worth aspiring to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I responded without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "I want to run like that," I told him. "As far as I can, past the horizon. I want to run with endless strength."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: He smiled and said, "I bet that would feel pretty good, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My body temperature raised slightly, which I identified as a state of "aspiration."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In short, this racewear reflects the warmth I felt at that moment.
choice_data_list: So that's why you designed it this way…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes… I gave it an S-rank myself, but what would you give it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you find it… odd?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I should have left the final decision up to you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Master's approval of my personal signature racewear… obtained.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Master.
Mihono Bourbon mumbles with slight embarrassment as we share a heart-warming moment together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you… really mean it?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: We are completely different from ships that fly through outer space, though…
I think that's exactly why she admires them. Just imagining all the speed and power of a spacecraft packed into a human form is exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Sharing of "feelings" verified.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Yes, Master. It is indeed very "awesome."
Mihono Bourbon gives a small, warm smile as we continue enjoying the planetarium.
